caption: The drawing consists of a detailed, shaded pencil sketch of a large tankard or stein positioned centrally on the page, shown in profile view. The tankard has a domed lid with a small round knob at the top, a wide cylindrical body with two horizontal ridges towards the top and bottom, and a large, ornate handle that includes decorative curls. Around the main drawing are four supplementary diagrams, each within rectangular borders and labeled with dimensions in inches. The upper left inset shows a front elevation of the handle with notations and a measurement. The upper right inset shows a piece labeled "Thumb Piece," displaying a cutout or shaped detail. The lower left inset is labeled "Final" and depicts a circular top view of the tankard with two crescent shapes. The lower right inset, labeled "Front View," presents a straight-on elevation of the tankard, highlighting its height and width. The overall color of the drawing is shades of grey pencil on off-white or light beige paper, with fine linework and shading used to suggest volume and depth. A handwritten scale and the word "Meyer" appear below the central drawing.
title: Pewter Tankard
